# Glovebox Gear

> Independent, hands-on reviews and buyer's guides for car accessories — the best dash cams, portable jump starters, tire inflators, floor mats and liners, phone mounts, car vacuums, and pressure washers for detailing. We weigh manufacturer specs against large volumes of verified owner reviews and rank each product against its direct competitors. Reader-supported via affiliate links; brands cannot pay for placement.

## Buying guides
- [Best Dash Cams](https://glovebox-gear.com/dash-cams.html): front, rear, and 3-channel cameras tested for footage quality and parking mode.
- [Best Portable Jump Starters](https://glovebox-gear.com/jump-starters.html): compact glovebox units to diesel-ready packs.
- [Best Portable Tire Inflators](https://glovebox-gear.com/tire-inflators.html): corded 12V and cordless, tested for fill speed and auto-shutoff.
- [Best Car Floor Mats & Liners](https://glovebox-gear.com/floor-mats.html): custom, semi-custom, and budget picks for interior protection.
- [Best Car Phone Mounts](https://glovebox-gear.com/phone-mounts.html): vent, dash, magnetic, and MagSafe options.
- [Best Car Vacuums](https://glovebox-gear.com/car-vacuums.html): corded 12V, cordless, and wet/dry picks.
- [Best Pressure Washers for Cars](https://glovebox-gear.com/pressure-washers.html): paint-safe pressure and foam-cannon setups.
